title: pilosella hyperborea
intro: Pilosella hyperborea, commonly known as Arctic mouse-ear, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella hyperborea include its ability to modulate immune responses, exert antimicrobial effects, and display potential anticancer properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
